name: Neo-Nazism
summary: Neo-Nazism is a family of post-1945 movements in several countries that take over the national-socialist outlook: a nation defined by race or descent, hostility to a Jewish or Zionist elite said to control money and media, rejection of liberal democracy and multiculturalism, and a strong national state serving the people. The branches share the closed-border, repatriation and race-separation aims and a mix of anti-capitalist and anti-Marxist economics, but differ on elections, religion, Holocaust history and how far they go beyond a defensive nationalism.
scope: Family entry. Branches read from their own programmes: the National Alliance (US, 'What is the National Alliance?', c. 2004 web copy) and the National Socialist Movement (US, 25-Point Plan), counted as one US branch; the NPD (2010 programme) and Der III. Weg (10-point programme), counted as one German branch because Der III. Weg grew out of the same milieu; the Nordic Resistance Movement (Our Path, 2016); and Golden Dawn in Greece, known only through a scholarly thesis that analyses its 2012 and 2015 documents, so it supports only medium. A position counts when at least two of these four independent branches state it and none states the opposite; high is used only where at least three do. Where branches differ (elections, religion, women's vote, expansion, central-bank control) the answer is 0 at low. Excluded: original Nazism (national-socialism), fascism, the alt-right and white nationalism, which have their own entries; Blood & Honour and other branches were not read from their own texts and are not used.

universal-healthcare.rationale: The NPD makes health care a basic right with one national health fund, Der III. Weg lists medical care among every German's rights, and the NRM promises free health and dental care, all for their own citizens.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: The National Alliance, the NPD, the NRM and Golden Dawn each reject laissez-faire for a state-directed or racially ordered economy while keeping competition and private initiative inside it.

public-ownership.rationale: The NPD puts rail, post, energy and water in state hands, Der III. Weg nationalises key industries, the NRM has the state control fundamental infrastructure, and Golden Dawn wants banks and natural resources nationalised.

property-fundamental.rationale: The NSM allows free expropriation for the public good, the NPD says property carries obligations, and Golden Dawn accepts property only short of unchecked profiteering, so private property is subordinate to the national interest.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: The NSM says individual activity must not counteract the interests of the whole, the NPD says the economy must serve the people and property carries obligations, and Golden Dawn condemns profiteering that burdens the community.

regulate-corporations.rationale: The NSM nationalises the trusts, the NPD demands a strict cartel law and a ban on hedge funds, Golden Dawn attacks unchecked profiteering, and the National Alliance says capital must not be able to rewrite society's rules.

cut-welfare.rationale: The NSM, the NPD, Der III. Weg and the NRM all keep or expand welfare and pensions for their own people, tied to a duty to work, so none calls for cutting it as such.

basic-income.rationale: The NPD rejects an unconditional basic income in favour of contribution-based benefits, and the NRM ends benefits for those who will not work; Der III. Weg makes work a duty.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: The NSM replaces the Federal Reserve with a national bank, the NPD wants a national central bank with sole power to create money, and the NRM wants a government-controlled central bank, so each keeps one under national control.

public-money-creation.rationale: The NPD gives a national central bank the sole right of money creation, the NRM gives a government-controlled central bank exclusive rights to create money, and the NSM turns the Federal Reserve into a bank owned by and accountable to citizens.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: The NRM puts a customs fee on goods it could make itself, the NPD sets a national protection policy against global free trade, and Der III. Weg and Golden Dawn aim at self-sufficiency.

free-trade.rationale: The NPD firmly rejects global free trade for a space-oriented national economy, the NRM taxes competing imports, Der III. Weg promotes a self-supplying economy and Golden Dawn wants a nationally directed economy.

state-directs-investment.rationale: The NPD wants state aid to key industries to give the state ownership rights, Der III. Weg nationalises key industries, and Golden Dawn favours a directed economy over laissez-faire.

widespread-small-property.rationale: The NSM wants a healthy middle class and small firms favoured, the NPD backs the Mittelstand, Der III. Weg backs family farms and firms, and the NRM backs small businesses and small-scale farming.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: The National Alliance wants people to reap the fruits of their labour and compete, the NSM and Der III. Weg make work a duty, and the NPD keeps wages and a minimum wage, so none abolishes money or wage labour.

profit-exploitation.rationale: The National Alliance, the NPD and the NRM all defend profit and private enterprise within national limits, and name interest, speculation or capital's power rather than ordinary profit as the abuse.

collective-farming.rationale: The NPD protects the independent farming class, Der III. Weg supports family farms, and the NRM promotes small-scale agriculture, so none wants collectivised farming.

class-struggle-history.rationale: The National Alliance puts race and natural selection at the centre of history, and the NPD, Der III. Weg and the NRM replace class conflict with national community.

equal-outcomes.rationale: The National Alliance rejects equalising outcomes as unnatural, Der III. Weg rejects levelling communism, and the NPD blames the dogma of human equality for falling standards.

class-collaboration.rationale: The NPD calls for justice to employers and workers alike inside the Volksgemeinschaft, the NRM says its government is loyal to no class, Der III. Weg wants every individual serving the whole people, and the National Alliance fears class warfare.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: The National Alliance contrasts itself with both Marxism and laissez-faire, Der III. Weg sets a German socialism apart from both, the NPD attacks liberal capitalism and egalitarianism, and Golden Dawn rejects both; the reference notes a Third Position that denounces both.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: The National Alliance, Der III. Weg and Golden Dawn explicitly reject Marxism or communism, and the NRM and NPD build on class cooperation, so a working-class dictatorship is excluded.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: The NSM abolishes unearned income, the NRM abolishes interest and taxes hoarded capital, and the NPD puts production before speculation and punishes usury.

job-guarantee.rationale: The NPD makes it the state's task to create and keep jobs, the NRM promises gainful work to every able-bodied person, and the NSM makes the state responsible for providing a livelihood.

local-production.rationale: The NPD backs regional economic circuits and local supply, the NRM subsidises local and organic products and tariffs imports, and Der III. Weg and Golden Dawn aim at self-sufficiency.

consumerism-harmful.rationale: The NPD blames the materialism of recent decades, the NRM wants the materially wasteful mentality replaced, and the NSM attacks a Jewish-materialistic spirit.

corporate-influence.rationale: The National Alliance says the rich can buy legislation, the NPD denounces the dictatorship of big capital, and the NRM says wealth buys media and power.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: The National Alliance says unrestricted capitalism lets the rich rewrite the rules, and the NPD and NRM tie the power of big capital and finance to loss of national freedom.

press-owned-by-wealth.rationale: The NRM says a hidden wealthy elite owns the media and shapes opinion, the NPD wants concentration of media power broken, and the National Alliance says Jewish interests control the media.

ban-cartels.rationale: The NPD demands an effective cartel law, the National Alliance condemns stifling competition, and the NSM nationalises trusts.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: The NPD rejects privatising pensions and wants one state-run fund, and the NRM raises the national pension until private savings are unnecessary.

targeted-social-spending.rationale: The NPD builds universal funds and a basic pension for all Germans, and the NRM gives free healthcare and a national pension to all citizens, so social spending is universal within the nation.

local-essentials-public.rationale: The NPD puts water, energy and hospitals under the state, and the NRM keeps fundamental infrastructure and health care public.

social-market-economy.rationale: The NPD wants free but socially bound enterprise with a cartel law, the NRM mixes private enterprise with state-held public-interest industries and a welfare net, and the National Alliance allows competition under racial limits.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: The NPD takes foreigners out of social insurance, the NRM limits the national pension to citizens, Der III. Weg states social justice for all Germans, and Golden Dawn runs Greeks-only services.

work-for-welfare.rationale: The NRM denies the welfare net to those who will not work, and the NSM, Der III. Weg and the NPD make work a duty of every citizen.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: The NPD, the NRM and the NSM all build state welfare for their own citizens and none puts the poor in the hands of private charity.

workers-nation.rationale: The NPD and Der III. Weg overcome international ideologies for the national community, and the NRM's government is loyal to the nation and not to a class.

patriotism-serves-workers.rationale: The NPD calls itself the voice of national and social Germany, Der III. Weg joins a national and socialist politics, the NSM demands nationalisation and profit-sharing for its people, and the NRM pairs nation and a social welfare state.

economy-in-majority-hands.rationale: The NPD reserves German land to Germans and subordinates the economy to the Volk, the NSM targets foreign and Jewish land speculators and trusts, and the NRM takes the money system and media from a Zionist elite.

national-resource-control.rationale: Golden Dawn would nationalise natural resources and refuse to sell them, the NPD reserves German land to Germans, and the NRM keeps its resources under national management.

foreign-takeover-block.rationale: The NPD wants to prevent foreign capital buying German firms, and Golden Dawn would keep Greek resources and industries from foreign hands.

surveillance-ok.rationale: The NPD wants an end to blanket surveillance, Der III. Weg fights growing surveillance, and the NRM says it protects personal privacy rather than build a surveillance society.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: The NPD wants the speech-crime sections of the penal code repealed, Der III. Weg wants the opinion paragraphs struck, and the NRM abolishes the hate-speech law, though it would add laws against anti-national propaganda.

strong-leader.rationale: The NRM has a leader acting without bureaucratic hassle, the NPD wants a directly elected president with more powers, Golden Dawn calls itself the only true national leadership, and the NSM wants a strong central power.

state-harmful.rationale: Every branch builds a strong state: the National Alliance a centralised continental government, the NSM a strong central power, the NPD and Der III. Weg a social nation-state, the NRM a powerful government, and Golden Dawn a military and police state.

night-watchman-state.rationale: The National Alliance says a minimal government is for the remote future, the NRM says the state must do more than keep order, and the NPD and Der III. Weg give it social and economic tasks.

empower-police-military.rationale: The NPD wants better-equipped forces and a visible police, the NRM expands the armed forces, and Golden Dawn would raise police and military funding and powers.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: The NPD wants a stronger police and tougher prisons, the NRM tougher penalties, and Golden Dawn a stronger police force, so none would abolish them.

decide-locally.rationale: The NRM leaves regional issues to regional bodies, but the NSM wants unlimited central authority, the National Alliance a centralised continental government and the NPD one national school system.

traditional-family.rationale: The NPD calls the family of father, mother and children the germ cell of the people, the NRM calls the hetero-norm the natural order of every healthy society, and the NSM and Der III. Weg protect the family as the base of the race or people.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: The NPD says same-sex partnerships are not a family and may not be promoted, and the NRM treats the homosexual lobby as a tool against the natural order.

gender-social-construct.rationale: The NPD rejects gender mainstreaming as contrary to nature and affirms natural differences between men and women, and the NRM defends the natural order against feminism and cultural Marxism.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: The NPD affirms the natural difference of the sexes and the NRM a natural order of the genders, which leaves little room for sex being socially constructed.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: The NRM fills posts by competence regardless of gender, and the NPD rejects gender mainstreaming, so equal representation by quota is rejected.

more-religion-public.rationale: The NSM backs a positive Christianity, while the National Alliance attacks church-bound, priest-ridden spirituality and the NRM only promises religious freedom.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: The National Alliance blames affirmative action and egalitarianism for decline, the NSM wants all positions for whites, and the NRM bans quotas and affirmative action.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: The NRM bans quotas and affirmative action, but the NSM reserves official appointments for white men, so the branches split on racial preferences in hiring.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: The NPD sets the state to protect the national culture from foreign influence, the NRM safeguards Nordic culture, the National Alliance wants education to pass on the European heritage, and Golden Dawn holds up a Hellenic national rebirth.

gradual-change.rationale: The National Alliance plans a revolutionary seizure of all power, Der III. Weg calls itself revolutionary and wants a total renewal, and Golden Dawn seeks radical rebirth, so none favours gradual change inside existing institutions.

revolution-justified.rationale: The National Alliance programme is a revolution to replace the existing power structure, Der III. Weg calls itself revolutionary, and Golden Dawn is reported to justify violence in the name of authentic democracy; the NPD works through elections.

reduce-immigration.rationale: The NPD demands a return duty for foreigners and no asylum right, the NRM a complete halt and repatriation, the NSM prevention of further non-white immigration, and Golden Dawn expulsion of immigrants.

open-borders.rationale: Every branch demands closed borders: the NPD ends Schengen and asylum, the NRM stops all non-Nordic immigration, the NSM forbids non-white immigration, and Golden Dawn wants immigrants expelled.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: The NPD refuses EU, UN and WTO rule over national self-determination, the NRM and Der III. Weg leave the EU, Golden Dawn rejects EU rule, and the National Alliance sees a hostile world order.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: The NPD, Der III. Weg, the NRM and Golden Dawn each demand leaving the European Union, and the NPD says no sovereignty may be handed over to it.

nation-first.rationale: The NPD aligns foreign policy solely with German interests, Der III. Weg says no German blood for foreign interests, the NRM secures its own people's needs first, and Golden Dawn puts the Greek nation above the EU.

national-law-over-international.rationale: The NPD says no EU, UN or WTO act may hollow out the people's self-determination, and the NRM and Golden Dawn reject rule by Brussels.

national-self-determination.rationale: The NPD says every people has a right to self-determination, the NSM demands self-determination of whites with their own territory, the NRM wants a sovereign Nordic nation, and Der III. Weg wants popular sovereignty.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: The NPD refuses interference in other states and Der III. Weg allows foreign missions only for Germany's own security, and the NSM would cut the military's global footprint to homeland defence.

non-intervention.rationale: The NPD states a principle of non-interference in other states' internal affairs, and the NSM wants the military back to defending the homeland.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: The NPD and Der III. Weg leave NATO and bring German soldiers home, and the NSM cuts the military's global footprint.

conscription.rationale: The NPD calls military service an honour duty, Der III. Weg restores conscription, the NRM reinstates it for at least two years, and Golden Dawn would lengthen and widen it.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: The NPD, Der III. Weg, the NRM, the NSM and Golden Dawn all want a strong national army, so disbanding the forces is out.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: The NPD calls service an honour and the NRM makes every citizen a defender, so refusing orders to fight is not their position.

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: The NPD wants a state monopoly on force, but the NRM lets conscript veterans keep their service rifles, and the National Alliance plans its own cadres.

natural-rulers.rationale: The National Alliance wants influence in proportion to ability and a trained ruling order, and the NRM picks senators and leaders by competence.

democracy-best.rationale: The National Alliance calls mass democracy a malignant monster, the NSM retires the multi-party system, and the NRM opposes present democracy, though the NPD and NRM claim a true people's democracy.

direct-votes.rationale: The NPD wants referendums at every level on national questions, and the NRM adds a Swiss-style direct democracy to its parliament.

separated-powers.rationale: The NPD secures the independence of the legislative, executive and judicial powers, and the NRM separates legislative from executive power in a constitutional state.

elective-rulers.rationale: The NPD wants a directly elected president, and the NRM rejects power by inheritance and has a parliament approve the leader.

democracy-is-procedure.rationale: The NPD claims democracy through referendums and elections, but the National Alliance and NSM would end mass or multi-party democracy.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: The NPD wants the president directly elected, but the NRM has a Senate appoint the leader and a parliament approve him.

racial-franchise.rationale: The NSM gives the vote to white male owners alone, the NRM only to citizens of Nordic descent, the NPD defines citizens by descent, and the National Alliance sees the enfranchisement of non-whites as ruinous.

foreign-residents-local-vote.rationale: The NRM gives only citizens the vote, and the NSM treats non-citizens as guests under foreigner legislation.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: The NPD restores citizenship by descent, the NRM grants it only to children of Nordic citizens or closely related people, and the NSM allows only whites to be citizens.

native-born-offices.rationale: The NRM lets government agencies hire almost only citizens, and the NSM reserves all official appointments to white male citizens.

ethnic-nation.rationale: The NPD says Germany must stay the land of the Germans, the NRM and National Alliance demand racially homogeneous nations, the NSM a white-only state, and Golden Dawn a pure Hellenic bloodline.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: The National Alliance wants white schools, neighbourhoods and workplaces, the NSM white-only citizenship, the NRM a racial assessment of citizens, and Golden Dawn segregated schools; the NPD separates German and foreign pupils.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: The National Alliance names miscegenation a problem and wants a racially clean area, the NRM calls promoting miscegenation genocide and wants races to live separately, and Golden Dawn upholds biological purity.

population-transfer.rationale: The NSM expels non-whites who immigrated since 1960, the NRM repatriates most non-Nordic residents, the NPD sets a return duty, the National Alliance deports non-white populations, and Golden Dawn expels immigrants.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: The NPD says multicultural societies split into parallel societies, the National Alliance calls multiculturalism a sickness destroying nations, and the NRM and Golden Dawn treat diversity as a threat to the people.

racial-group-interests.rationale: The National Alliance, NSM, NRM and Golden Dawn all organise around the interests of one race or people, and the NPD around the German Volk.

racial-pride.rationale: The National Alliance wants racial patriots and Aryan consciousness taught, the NSM defends European-American pride, the NRM praises its racial heritage and Golden Dawn exalts the Hellenic race.

hereditarian-race.rationale: The National Alliance says races differ in mental capacity through natural selection, the NRM says races differ in intelligence, character and personality, and Golden Dawn holds a biological conception of the nation.

race-social-construct.rationale: The National Alliance, the NRM and Golden Dawn hold race to be a biological reality, and the NSM calls itself a white racial movement.

character-from-environment.rationale: The National Alliance rejects the view that differences in attainment are circumstantial, and the NRM says races differ in character and personality.

disparate-impact-discrimination.rationale: The National Alliance holds that racial differences in attainment are natural, and the NRM that races differ in ability, so unequal outcomes are not discrimination to them.

elite-replacement.rationale: The NPD says the established parties want to replace the people, the NRM calls mass immigration a genocide promoted by media and government, the National Alliance blames collaborators with Jews, and Golden Dawn calls immigration a plan to destroy ethnic identity.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: The National Alliance says Jews control media and government, the NSM calls Jews a threat to the nation, the NRM names a global Zionist elite, and Golden Dawn blames international Zionism.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: The National Alliance calls governments terminally corrupt, the NRM calls its government criminal, the NPD attacks the system parties, the NSM opposes partisan appointments and Golden Dawn attacks a corrupt political class.

media-academia-power.rationale: The NRM says media power exceeds that of politicians and the National Alliance says Jewish-controlled media steer government, though neither speaks of universities.

mass-culture-pacifies.rationale: The National Alliance says the media hypnotise the public, the NRM says media steer opinion and confuse and destabilise society, and the NPD calls the media an instrument of conformity.

duties-before-rights.rationale: The NPD says personal freedom ends where the community is harmed, the NRM puts the people's freedoms above the individual's, Der III. Weg's motto is from I to We, and the National Alliance ranks race and cause above the self.

person-over-state.rationale: The NPD makes the state the protector of the people and the NRM the collective above the individual, and the National Alliance subordinates the individual to race.

individual-rights-only.rationale: The NPD holds that the people has a right to self-determination, the NRM holds that the people's sovereignty outranks individual freedom, and the NSM claims a right of self-determination for whites.

harm-principle.rationale: The NPD ends personal freedom where the community is harmed, and the NRM withdraws freedoms used against the Nordic people.

self-ownership.rationale: The NRM and NPD require military service and subordinate the person to the people, and the National Alliance plans a state eugenics programme, which full self-ownership would rule out.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: The NSM, the NRM, the NPD and the National Alliance all call for compulsory removal of non-members, which initiates force against persons and property for a national goal.

taxation-theft.rationale: The NRM calls government an integral part of the national community that earns its taxes, and the NPD builds the state budget on taxes.

single-common-good.rationale: The NPD puts the state above group interests in the interest of the whole Volk, and the NRM and Der III. Weg hold up the good of the people as one.

national-rebirth.rationale: Golden Dawn promises a rebirth of the nation, Der III. Weg a total renewal at every level, the National Alliance a new world from the ruins of the present one, and the NRM a new politics for a new time.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Golden Dawn revives the Megali Idea and the National Alliance wants open space for expansion, but the NPD, Der III. Weg and the NRM state only defensive or peaceful aims.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: The NPD and Der III. Weg restrict forces to defence, but the NRM allows preventive force and Golden Dawn aims at expansion.

sacred-nation.rationale: The NPD takes Herder's view that peoples are thoughts of God and makes preserving the people the highest aim, and the National Alliance makes the race's future the supreme duty.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: The NPD wants a national history centred on the continuity of the people's life, and Golden Dawn calls the Greeks the authentic continuation of the ancient Greeks.

homeland-spiritual-bond.rationale: The NPD says nature protection is homeland protection and asserts a right of homeland, Der III. Weg says environmental protection is homeland protection, and the NRM ties a people to its land and nature.

historical-land-claim.rationale: The National Alliance claims the lands its ancestors took, the NPD asserts a right of homeland and contests post-war borders, and Golden Dawn claims former Greek lands.

history-own-civilization.rationale: The NPD wants a national picture of history, the National Alliance an education passing on the European heritage to make racial patriots, and the NRM emphasises Nordic culture and history.

patriotic-education.rationale: The NPD wants the national culture and honour of the people cultivated in schools, the National Alliance makes racial patriots of pupils, and the NRM replaces democratic teaching with national-community values.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: The NPD gives child benefits and a mothers' salary only to German families, Der III. Weg fights the death of the people with support for large families, and the NRM doubles parental leave and raises child allowances.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: The NRM says a form of government must suit its people and may not fit China, Somalia or Brazil, the National Alliance wants societies for each white people on its own roots, and the NPD honours the diversity of peoples.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: The National Alliance, NRM and Golden Dawn rank races and peoples, while the NPD honours the diversity of peoples as bearers of cultures without ranking them.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: The National Alliance rejects equality and the NSM gives rights to whites alone, but the NPD says people are equal before the law and in dignity.

religious-nation.rationale: The National Alliance, NSM and NRM define the nation by race, and the NPD by descent, language and history, not by religion.

religious-exemptions.rationale: The NPD treats kosher-style slaughter as a crime and the NRM bans kosher and halal slaughter, so neither exempts minority religious practice.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: The NPD calls animals living beings with feelings and punishes cruelty, and the NRM says humans must not cause animals unnecessary suffering.

animal-use-humane.rationale: The NPD allows animal tests only in a limited number for medicine and rejects factory farming, and the NRM allows hunting and farming under humane rules and bans painful testing.

nature-intrinsic-value.rationale: The NRM opposes treating animals and nature as only serving humans, and the NPD says nature is not merely humanity's environment.

future-generations.rationale: The NRM aims at a sustainable planet for many generations and the NPD demands finance and ecology that serve later generations.

gm-crops.rationale: The NPD bans genetically modified food and cultivation, and the NRM enforces rules against GMOs.

rural-life-healthier.rationale: The NRM calls big cities unsound places that degenerate people and wants a vibrant countryside, and the NPD calls the farming class of cultural importance.

death-penalty.rationale: The NSM punishes common national criminals and usurers with death, the NRM introduces capital punishment for the worst crimes, and the NPD wants a referendum on restoring it.

extrajudicial-killing.rationale: The NRM allows capital punishment only with evidence beyond reasonable doubt, and the NPD wants strict rule-of-law principles, so killing without trial is not their position.

socialized-care.rationale: The NPD says responsibility for children lies first with the family and the mother, and the NRM elevates the mother's family role though it offers free childcare as needed.

diaspora-return-right.rationale: The NPD says Germans living abroad must always be able to return, and the NRM grants asylum to persecuted racial kin.

reunify-divided-nation.rationale: The NPD and Der III. Weg demand the reunification of Germany within its historical borders, and the NRM unites the Nordic countries in one state.

dominated-front.rationale: The NRM allies with governments willing to topple the world order, and Golden Dawn's National Plan seeks trade ties with Russia, China and Iran against American and German influence.

civilizational-union.rationale: The NRM and Der III. Weg seek Nordic and European unions, but the NPD and Golden Dawn reject supranational union and want sovereign nation-states.

kin-peoples-union.rationale: The NRM unites the Nordic peoples and the National Alliance links the white world, but the NPD and Golden Dawn reject political union.

common-currency.rationale: The NRM wants a joint Nordic currency and central bank, but the NPD and Golden Dawn want separate national currencies.

central-bank-independence.rationale: The NPD wants a national central bank free of government instructions, but the NRM and NSM put the central bank under government or citizen control.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: The NRM offers generous conditional foreign aid after its own needs, but the National Alliance withdraws aid and the NPD stops payments abroad without return.

experts-over-public.rationale: The National Alliance and NRM give trained or competent officials the ruling role, but the NPD and NRM add referendums that give the public the last word.

total-state.rationale: The National Alliance and NRM have the state shape education, culture and the economy, but the NPD wants media pluralism and the NRM keeps private enterprise.

direct-action.rationale: The National Alliance holds that elections cannot bring power and builds a revolutionary structure, while the NPD and the NRM also use elections.

suppress-opposition.rationale: The NSM and NRM would close or ban organisations opposed to them, but the NPD demands freedom of opinion and organisation for dissenters.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: The NSM would close organisations opposing its demands and the NRM would prosecute groups promoting immigration, but the NPD opposes bans and abolishes the Verfassungsschutz.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: The NSM prosecutes art and literature harmful to national life, but the NPD calls speech and thought bans unworthy of a free state.

party-controls-media.rationale: The NRM wants most media state-owned and able to ban hostile outlets and the NSM restricts the press, but the NPD wants media pluralism and neutral public broadcasters.

public-service-media.rationale: The NPD wants public broadcasters politically neutral, but the NRM wants government-owned media that works for the people.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: The NSM and National Alliance restrict public roles by sex, but the NPD demands equal pay and the NRM fills posts by competence regardless of gender.

women-suffrage.rationale: The NSM gives the vote to adult white men alone and the National Alliance laments women's enfranchisement, but the NRM and NPD do not exclude women.

economic-self-sufficiency.rationale: The NPD, Der III. Weg, the NRM and Golden Dawn aim at self-sufficiency, but the NRM says it is not against importing goods, so a shut-off bloc is not the shared aim.

production-for-use.rationale: The NPD says the economy's purpose is to meet the people's needs, but the National Alliance and NRM keep profit incentives.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: The National Alliance puts competition and struggle at the centre, but the NPD says the social nation-state prevents the war of all against all.

notes: Of 490 statements, 155 carry a value (high where three or more of the four branches state the position, medium for two, low for documented splits); the rest are null because the programmes read are silent or only one branch speaks. The German branch (NPD, Der III. Weg) is more parliamentary and welfare-oriented than the US and Nordic ones, and the NPD says it is not against Islam as a religion; Golden Dawn is read only through one thesis and itself rejects the neo-Nazi label.
